$comment: Colour language gate rules CL1-CL7 (PROPOSAL-color-language.md section 7). A component id in 'migrated' makes CL2-CL6 blocking for it; an id in 'slotOnlyBlocking' makes CL1 blocking for it. '*' means every component. Add a batch's ids when that batch is migrated. CL7 (slot contrast pairs) is foundation-wide and blocks only when 'contrastBlocking' is true.

literalColorAllow.$comment: colourMath: component code that computes colours (hsl()/oklch() ramps, color-mix of user paint). contentFixtures: fixtures whose literal colours are user content (swatches, themes, images, artwork), not UI chrome.
